comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader once and return it to its stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and guide a thin card through a narrow slot at controlled speed without reversal.
comparison.success_condition: One continuous valid-speed read across the encoded span, followed by stable released insertion in the stand; extra or failed swipes reduce credit.
comparison.reason: Narrow-slot trajectory control and read-speed regulation are unrelated to carton classification, body grasping, articulated-obstacle avoidance, and content retention.
